Alger, 17 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 17, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algeria has secured a seat on the Council of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) for the Africa region, covering the 2027-2030 term. The election took place during the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference (PP-26) held in Doha, Qatar.
